scope: Four auxiliary field-rate diagnostics, nine guard transport theorems, and the bound of both guard transport residuals by the full six-field difference energy, uniform on a finite interval under the stated extra joint guard-gradient regularity. The time-dependent full difference-energy balance, remaining estimates, PDE existence and uniqueness remain open.
open_items: Construct local coupled variable-viscosity PDE solutions in an appropriate spatial function space.
Prove continuation/global estimates for the every-finite-horizon existence target.
Derive the integrated two-history energy balance, guard invariant range, and the remaining transport, stress and reaction estimates from the actual PDE solutions.
Formalize the full classical uniqueness argument and specify its relation to the saved solution class.
Submit actual existence and uniqueness proofs to Comparator.
